items.definition:
relating to armed forces
He has a long career in the military.

governmental, national
The federal government announced new policies.

relating to economics or the economy
The country is facing economic challenges.

financial
He has some financial problems.

relating to or belonging to a profession
She always maintains a professional attitude at work.

clearly defined or identified
Please give me specific instructions.

used or accepted as normal or average
This is the standard procedure.

restricted in size, amount, or extent
We have a limited amount of time.

opposed to
She is very anti-war.

possible
He has great potential as a leader.

single; separate
Each individual student received a certificate.

specific; distinct
Is there any particular reason you chose that color?

important, notable
There was a significant increase in sales.

global
Climate change is a global issue.

annual
The company holds an annual meeting.

relating to ordinary citizens and their concerns; polite
We need to maintain civil discourse.

magnificent and impressive
The old building had a grand staircase.

general, total
The overall cost was higher than expected.

successful in producing a desired result
The new strategy was very effective.

dedicated or consecrated to God or a religious purpose
The church is considered a holy place by many.

complicated, intricate
The problem was too complex to solve quickly.

existing or coming before in time, order, or importance
You need to get prior approval for this.

expressing adverse or disapproving comments or judgments; involving the objective analysis and evaluation of an issue
It is critical that we finish this project on time.

relating to the mind
He is doing mental arithmetic.

relating to the instincts, physiological processes, and activities connected with physical attraction or reproduction.
The film contains some sexual content.

of first importance; main
His prime concern is the safety of his family.

firm
The ground was firm after the rain.

relating to culture
We visited many cultural sites on our trip.

relating to a particular subject, art, or craft, or its techniques
He has a lot of technical knowledge about computers.

being the only one of its kind; unlike anything else
Each snowflake is unique.

profoundly immoral and wicked
He believed the villain was truly evil.

relating to democracy
The country has a democratic government.

relating to atomic energy
The country is developing nuclear power.

very large
The building was massive and impressive.

relating to a region
They discussed regional differences in dialect.

ready or prepared to do something
She was willing to help with the project.

available as another possibility
We need to find an alternative solution.

relating to industry
The city has a large industrial area.

relating to the natural world
We need to address environmental issues.

relating to a republic
The country has a republican form of government.

relating to home or country
We need to address domestic issues first.

the smallest possible amount
You need a minimum of three years' experience.

suitable or proper
Wear appropriate clothing for the interview.

relating to science
They conducted a scientific experiment.

relating to emotions
It was an emotional moment for everyone.

inside
The company conducted an internal investigation.

open to new ideas
He has very liberal views on education.

numerous
There were numerous reasons for the delay.

corporate
He works in corporate law.

minor
It was a minor issue, easily resolved.

holding to traditional attitudes and values; cautious
He has very conservative views on economic policy.

closely connected or appropriate to what is being considered
Your comments are not relevant to the discussion.

relating to education
The program has great educational value.

made, done, or happening without method or conscious decision
The survey selected participants at random.

relating to education and scholarship
She has a strong academic background.

relating to or characterized by competition
The market for smartphones is very competitive.

lasting or intended to last or remain unchanged indefinitely
She is looking for a permanent job.

restricted, high-end
This offer is exclusive to our members.

second of two, near the end
Of the two options, I prefer the latter.

relating to the Roman Catholic Church; universal
She grew up in a Catholic family.

complete; total
He spoke with absolute confidence.

continuous; unchanging
The constant noise was annoying.

many; more than one
This is a multi-purpose tool.

relating to the former Soviet Union
The Soviet Union dissolved in 1991.
